panels.title: How a key maps to a person

options.content:
### Keys and people are the same picture here

LiteLLM stores a **key** and a **person** as separate things, joined by the key's `user_id`. The spend log only ever holds the **hashed** key, which is why the two look unrelated in the raw tables. Every panel below resolves them:

```
person = spendlog.user
      -> metadata.user_api_key_user_id
      -> VerificationToken.user_id   (the key's owner)
      -> spendlog.end_user
```

`metadata` comes first deliberately: LiteLLM copies the key's alias and owner into each spend row, so attribution **survives the key being deleted** — a plain join loses those rows.

**`(master key)` means attributed to nobody.** `LITELLM_MASTER_KEY` is a superuser credential with no owner and no budget, so its usage cannot be billed to a person and no ceiling binds it. Anything in that row is usage you cannot account for — give those callers their own key (Admin → People).

targets.rawSql: select count(distinct coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)')) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused'

panels.title: Requests
panels.description: Requests the gateway took, every surface. A refused request (a rate limit, credit or a budget, the safeguards) is not counted: it is under Refused.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused'

select coalesce(sum(greatest(s.prompt_tokens - s.cached_tokens, 0)),0) as "In", coalesce(sum(s.cached_tokens),0) as "Cached", coalesce(sum(s.completion_tokens),0) as "Out" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)
select round(coalesce(sum(s.cost),0)::numeric,4) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Attributed
panels.description: Share of requests that resolve to a real person. Anything short of 100% is usage nobody is accountable for.

targets.rawSql: select round(100.0*count(*) filter (where s.person is not null)/nullif(count(*),0),1) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused'

panels.title: Requests with no person
panels.description: Unowned and unbounded. Should be zero in steady state.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused' and s.person is null

panels.title: Per person — every surface combined
panels.description: One row per person, API and web UI summed. This is the number to bill, quota or argue about.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as "Person", count(*) as "Requests", coalesce(sum(greatest(s.prompt_tokens - s.cached_tokens, 0)),0) as "In", coalesce(sum(s.cached_tokens),0) as "Cached", coalesce(sum(s.completion_tokens),0) as "Out", coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as "Tokens", round(coalesce(sum(s.cost),0)::numeric,4) as "Spend", count(distinct coalesce(s.key_alias, s.surface)) as "Keys used", string_agg(distinct case s.surface when 'chat' then 'Chat' when 'app' then 'Arena itself' when 'studio' then 'Code Studio' when 'media' then 'Pictures, video, sound' else 'API / agent' end, ', ') as "Surfaces" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused' group by 1 order by 6 desc nulls last

panels.title: Which key belongs to whom
panels.description: The key inventory, as the app keeps it: each key's name, its person (by the requests it made), what may be shown of it (its last four characters: the key itself is shown once when it is made, and kept only as its SHA-256), its spend in the ledger and its own 30-day budget.

targets.rawSql: select k.alias as "Key alias", coalesce(r.person, '(no request yet)') as "Owner", k.preview as "Key (masked)", round(coalesce(r.spend, 0)::numeric, 4) as "Spend", coalesce(k.monthly_budget, 0) as "Budget", k.created_at as "Created" from api_keys k left join (select key_hash, sum(cost) as spend, max(person) as person from requests where key_hash is not null group by key_hash) r on r.key_hash = k.hash order by "Spend" desc nulls last

select $__timeGroupAlias(s.started_at, 1d), coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as metric, coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as tokens from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Tokens per day, by surface
panels.description: API keys, the web UI's shared key, and anything still riding the master key -- side by side.

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(s.started_at, 1d), case s.surface when 'chat' then 'Chat' when 'app' then 'Arena itself' when 'studio' then 'Code Studio' when 'media' then 'Pictures, video, sound' else 'API / agent' end as metric, coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as tokens from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Spend this month, by person and kind
panels.description: What each person spent since the start of this month, one row for each kind of credit (the chat, API keys, pictures, video, speech). Their credits and their groups' are set under People and Groups -- see docs/USAGE-LIMITS.md.

targets.rawSql: select m.person as "Person", m.credit_kind as "Kind", round(m.spend::numeric,4) as "Spend" from month_spend m order by m.spend desc

panels.title: Unattributed usage — fix these
panels.description: Requests that resolve to nobody. Almost always the master key in a client config -- replace it with a per-person key.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(s.key_alias, '(none)') as "Key", s.surface as "Surface", coalesce(s.tag, '') as "Tag", count(*) as "Requests", coalesce(sum(s.total_tokens),0) as "Tokens" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused' and s.person is null group by 1, 2, 3 order by 4 desc

panels.title: Refused
panels.description: Requests the gateway refused before any model: a key's rate limits (requests or tokens a minute, requests at once), credit or a budget, the safeguards, a key unknown, blocked or expired, a model the key may not use, no room on the model. Who, with which key, why, how often and when last. They are not counted as requests or failures in the other panels. The gateway keeps no prompt or answer with a refusal.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as "Person", coalesce(s.key_alias, s.surface) as "Key", case s.refusal when 'rpm' then 'requests a minute' when 'tpm' then 'tokens a minute' when 'parallel' then 'requests at once' when 'budget' then 'a budget' when 'credit' then 'credit' when 'key' then 'unknown key' when 'blocked' then 'key blocked' when 'expired' then 'key expired' when 'disabled' then 'account disabled' when 'api_off' then 'API access off' when 'model' then 'model not allowed' when 'safeguards' then 'safeguards' when 'room' then 'no room on the model' when 'busy' then 'busy' when 'too_long' then 'too long' else 'other' end as "Why", count(*) as "Refused", max(s.started_at) as "Last" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status = 'refused' group by 1,2,3 order by 4 desc, 5 desc

panels.title: Recent requests, resolved
panels.description: The raw rows with the person and key resolved. If a total above looks wrong, it is wrong here first.

targets.rawSql: select s.started_at as "Time", coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as "Person", coalesce(s.key_alias, s.surface) as "Key", case s.surface when 'chat' then 'Chat' when 'app' then 'Arena itself' when 'studio' then 'Code Studio' when 'media' then 'Pictures, video, sound' else 'API / agent' end as "Surface", s.model as "Model", s.prompt_tokens as "Prompt", s.completion_tokens as "Completion", round(coalesce(s.cost,0)::numeric,6) as "Spend" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused' order by s.started_at desc limit 200

panels.title: Tokens and cost — cached and uncached input priced separately
Input tokens, cache miss
panels.description: Prompt tokens the engine had to process: charged at the model's input price (Admin → Models, else Settings → Prices).

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(greatest(coalesce(s.prompt_tokens,0) - s.cached_tokens, 0)),0) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Input tokens, cache hit
panels.description: Prompt tokens served from the engine's prefix cache (a resent conversation or system prompt): charged at the model's cached input price (Admin → Models, else Settings → Prices).

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(s.cached_tokens),0) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Prompt cache hit
panels.description: Share of prompt tokens that came from the cache.

targets.rawSql: select round(100.0*sum(s.cached_tokens)/nullif(sum(coalesce(s.prompt_tokens,0)),0),1) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Output tokens
panels.description: Generated tokens, reasoning included: charged at the model's output price (Admin → Models, else Settings → Prices).

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(sum(s.completion_tokens),0) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Cost
panels.description: What the gateway charged, request by request, at the prices the model had when each request ran (Admin → Models, else Settings → Prices).

targets.rawSql: select round(coalesce(sum(s.cost),0)::numeric,4) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Cost per 1M tokens
panels.description: Effective blended price: cost divided by all tokens, cached input included.

targets.rawSql: select round((1e6*sum(s.cost)/nullif(sum(coalesce(s.total_tokens,0)),0))::numeric,4) as v from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at)

panels.title: Tokens and cost per person
panels.description: Per person, every surface combined. Cost is what the gateway recorded per request. Output tokens a second: how fast that person's answers streamed, after their first token.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as "Person", count(*) as "Requests", sum(greatest(coalesce(s.prompt_tokens,0) - s.cached_tokens, 0)) as "Input, cache miss", sum(s.cached_tokens) as "Input, cache hit", round(100.0*sum(s.cached_tokens)/nullif(sum(coalesce(s.prompt_tokens,0)),0),1) as "Cache hit %", sum(coalesce(s.completion_tokens,0)) as "Output", round((sum(s.completion_tokens - 1) filter (where s.first_token_at is not null and s.ended_at > s.first_token_at and s.completion_tokens > 1) / nullif(sum(extract(epoch from (s.ended_at - s.first_token_at))) filter (where s.first_token_at is not null and s.ended_at > s.first_token_at and s.completion_tokens > 1), 0))::numeric, 1) as "Output tokens a second", round(sum(s.cost)::numeric,4) as "Cost" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) and s.status <> 'refused' group by 1 order by "Cost" desc nulls last

select $__timeGroupAlias(s.started_at, $__interval), sum(greatest(coalesce(s.prompt_tokens,0) - s.cached_tokens, 0)) as "input, cache miss", sum(s.cached_tokens) as "input, cache hit", sum(coalesce(s.completion_tokens,0)) as "output" from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) group by 1 order by 1
select $__timeGroupAlias(s.started_at, $__interval), coalesce(s.person, '(unattributed)') as metric, sum(s.cost) as cost from requests s where $__timeFilter(s.started_at) group by 1, 2 order by 1

panels.title: Time — the model's, the tools', the people's
Chat time, the model
panels.description: The model's time writing the chats' answers (Code Arena's too), every round.

targets.rawSql: select round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as v from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at) and t.part = 'model'

panels.title: Chat time, tools
panels.description: The tools' time in the chats: their runs, sub-agents included.

targets.rawSql: select round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as v from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at) and t.part = 'tools'

panels.title: Chat time, people
panels.description: The people's time before each question: reading the answer, writing the next; a break past 15 minutes, or a chat's first question, a minute.

targets.rawSql: select round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as v from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at) and t.part = 'human'

panels.title: Chat time, all
panels.description: The model, tools and people together.

targets.rawSql: select round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as v from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at)

panels.title: Chat time per day: the model, tools, people
panels.description: Hours a day, stacked: the model's (answers), the tools' (their runs), the people's (before each question; a break past 15 minutes a minute).

targets.rawSql: select $__timeGroupAlias(t.at, 1d), case t.part when 'model' then 'The model' when 'tools' then 'Tools' else 'People' end as metric, round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as hours from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at) group by 1,2 order by 1

panels.title: Chat time per person
panels.description: Per person, Code Arena's sessions included: hours of the model, of tools and of their own.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(t.person, '(unattributed)') as "Person", round(coalesce(sum(t.ms) filter (where t.part = 'model'),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as "The model, h", round(coalesce(sum(t.ms) filter (where t.part = 'tools'),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as "Tools, h", round(coalesce(sum(t.ms) filter (where t.part = 'human'),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as "Own, h", round(coalesce(sum(t.ms),0) / 3600000.0, 2) as "All, h" from chat_times t where $__timeFilter(t.at) group by 1 order by "All, h" desc
